title: Magma slides deck
description: Frontmatter contract for a Magma slide deck (Markdown + frontmatter). Validates the deck-wide frontmatter and each slide's frontmatter.

tokens.description: Per-deck overrides of --mds-slide-* custom properties (theming cascade level 3).

header.description: Show the header zone on every slide (default false).

footer.description: Show the footer zone on every slide (default false).

logo.description: Company logo (URL/path); embedded when local. Falls back to the theme logo.

section.description: Current section/chapter. Sticky: carries forward to later slides.

pageNumbers.description: Show the automatic page number wherever the theme places it (default true).

header.description: Force the header on (true) or off (false) on this slide, over the layout default.

footer.description: Force the footer on (true) or off (false) on this slide, over the layout default.

logo.description: Company logo (URL/path); embedded when local. Falls back to the theme logo.

section.description: Current section/chapter. Sticky: carries forward to later slides.

pageNumbers.description: Show the automatic page number wherever the theme places it (default true).

theme.description: Slide theme: a folder under theme/themes/, named as the Magma theme it pairs with (set as data-theme-name). Placement of the header/footer elements belongs to the theme.

scheme.description: Color scheme, independent of the theme.
